AI Overview
No, a tested product photography prompt cannot guarantee the same output if the model ID and seed are not recorded. 
Reddit
·r/ArtificialInteligence
Why the Output Will Change
Random Initialization: Generative image models start from random noise. Without a fixed seed, every generation begins from a different random baseline. 
www.aiprophotography.com
Model Versions & Updates: If you do not record the specific model ID (such as a base checkpoint, fine-tune, or API version), underlying updates, silent hotfixes, or provider-side changes will alter how the words in your prompt are interpreted.
Sampling and Hardware Variability: Even with identical text prompts, factors like sampling behavior, temperature settings, batching, and hardware execution context introduce variance. 
manuelgarcia.info
 +1
According to discussions on Reddit, there is a community consensus that AI-generated images can only be precisely reproduced if the exact model, settings, and seed are tracked and locked.
